name: What is gas line pressure testing?

mainEntity.name: What is gas line pressure testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gas line pressure testing is a crucial safety procedure that involves introducing pressurized air or an inert gas into your gas lines to check for leaks. A gauge monitors the pressure over a specific time period. If the pressure drops, it indicates a leak in the system, which then needs to be located and repaired. This test helps ensure the integrity and safety of your gas piping, preventing potential hazards like gas leaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gas line pressure testing uses pressurized air to check for leaks in your gas lines, ensuring safety and system integrity.
